contentPattern: One row per tab: cell 1 = tab label ('How to Play', 'Prizes & Odds'); cell 2 = panel content (paragraphs, PDF download links, lists). Keep every tab and its label even when a panel is empty or only says 'SEE IN GAME FOR PRIZE STRUCTURE'. Drop empty paragraph/line-break fillers.
reuseGuidance: Use for short sets of equal-width tabs inside a bordered box (game How to Play / Prizes & Odds). Tab count is driven by the number of rows.
